$comment: 🚦️ Authored admission cases of a write or a build against the cap and the partition watermarks: the policy, what the store holds, the bytes about to be written, the partition and whether a collection already ran within the minimum age, with the expected action and reason. Read by the TypeScript rule and by the independent Python oracle.

cases.name: a partition above its high share collects in the background
after a collection a high partition goes on
a critical partition waits for a collection
a partition still critical after a collection refuses
the bytes about to be written count toward the share
exactly the critical share is critical
an unmeasured partition and an unknown store measure the store
a store above its cap waits for a collection
after a collection a store that stays above its cap goes on because the rest is pinned
a store above its high watermark collects in the background
a critical partition is judged before the cap
an unmeasured partition falls back to the cap rules

needs.name: below the high share nothing is needed
at the high share nothing is needed
above the high share the excess over the low share is needed
a full partition needs the whole excess over the low share
